milestones.theme: The Ninefold Matrix, Alternating Turn Protocol & Collinear Triad Arbiter

deliverables.title: Centered 9-sector orthogonal lattice (`three ranks by three files`) rendered with glowing architectural dividers, sector coordinate mapping, and dual Mouse-Click + Keyboard (`WASD`/`Arrows` + `SPACE`) sector selection.

Alternating turn state machine (`PLAYER_TURN` -> `AI_THINKING` -> `ROUND_OVER`), immutable sector claiming, evaluation of all 8 collinear triads (3 ranks, 3 files, 2 diagonals) plus 9-sector Equilibrium Deadlock detection, and instant `[SPACE]` / Click bout reset.

Animated geometric sigil drawing (*Intersecting Diagonal Blades* vs. *Concentric Meridian Ring*), radial particle bursts upon inscription, and a blazing harmonic laser beam connecting the 3 aligned sectors on victory.

milestones.theme: Contender Sigil Customization, Minimax Oracle AI & Threat Telemetry

deliverables.title: Pre-series Contender Configuration Modal allowing the player to choose their Geometric Crest palette, select who claims the opening turn (`Initiator First` vs `Arbiter First` vs `Alternating`), and select the Arbiter's cognitive tier (*Tier I: Opportunist*, *Tier II: Tactical Blocker*, *Tier III: Perfect Minimax Oracle*).

Three-tier Synthetic Arbiter AI: Tier I claims random/adjacent sectors; Tier II detects and blocks any collinear vector where the opponent holds 2 of 3 sectors; Tier III executes full recursive Minimax lookahead (prioritizing immediate winning triads, blocking opponent threats, seizing the central nexus or corner anchors, and setting up dual-vector forks).
Translucent ghost-sigil hover preview inside vacant sectors and subtle pulsing threat-threads along any rank, file, or diagonal where a contender holds 2 of 3 sectors.

milestones.theme: Pentatonic Crystal Audio Synthesizer, Championship Series & Blitz Clock

deliverables.title: Centralized Web Audio API harmonic synthesizer: 9 distinct pentatonic crystal chime frequencies mapped to the 9 matrix sectors, deep sub-bass lock thuds on placement, triumphant chord fanfare on Triad Victory, and a suspended chord resolve on Equilibrium Deadlock.
Best-of-5 Championship Series & Streak Multiplier system tracking Tactical Forks, Center-Nexus Control, and Flawless Series Sweeps inside the top status ribbon.
Optional 5.0-second Blitz Turn Timer integrated diegetically into the outer frame of the Ninefold Matrix (pulsing faster during the final 2 seconds and awarding speed-placement score bonuses).

milestones.theme: Ephemeral Decay Mutator & Quantum Swap Protocol

deliverables.title: Optional "Ephemeral Protocol" mutator toggle (`[KeyM]` or pre-match toggle): each contender may only maintain at most 3 active sigils on the lattice at once—when a contender inscribes their 4th sigil, their oldest sigil on the lattice dissolves back into a vacant sector, making Equilibrium Deadlocks impossible!
Shimmering half-life decay indicators and disintegration particle motes on whichever sigil is queued to vanish next under Ephemeral Protocol.
Diegetic turn-order age pips (`1`, `2`, `3`) subtly etched into the corner of each occupied sector so both contenders can read the decay queue at a glance.

milestones.theme: Grand Arbiter Coronation, Match Replay & Master Ledger

deliverables.title: End-of-Series Grand Arbiter Verdict Modal displaying Series Outcome, Strategic Rating (`S-RANK: GRAND GEOMETER` to `C-RANK: INITIATE`), Win/Deadlock/Loss breakdown, Top-5 Observatory Ledger, and `[SPACE]` New Series / `[C]` Reconfigure Protocol.
Constellation background starfield that links won bouts into glowing zodiac geometries behind the lattice, plus a slow-motion harmonic shatter finale when a Championship Series is clinched.

Concise, atmospheric philosophical axioms from the Observatory Arbiter inscribed along the bottom border of the Verdict Modal reflecting the player's tactical style (Corner Dominance, Center Control, or Fork Mastery).
